name: C11_PI_TREEWIDTH3_OR_LIST3_TERMINAL_GATE_V1

treewidth2_terminal.role: Retained authority; subsumed by tw<=3 for this gate.

frozen_terminal_stack.input: For each authoritative C11 survivor pair and each PI assignment (gamma,delta) in {3,4}^2, after exact frozen propagation/preprocessing and connected-component decomposition, classify every surviving connected residual component C with exact current lists.

case_0.label: CONTRADICTION
case_0.condition: Exact frozen propagation reaches an already-authorized contradiction certificate such as an empty list or improper fixed edge.

case_1.label: L3_READY
case_1.condition: There exists c in [4] absent from every list in C.

case_2.label: TW3_LIST_READY
case_2.positive_certificate: Verified tree decomposition with all bags of size at most 4.
case_2.raw_state_bound: At most 4^4=256 bag assignments before pruning.

case_3.label: TW3_FORBIDDEN_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
case_3.condition: C is connected, noncontradictory, not L3_READY, and tw(C)>3.
case_3.equivalent_condition: C contains at least one of {K5, OCTAHEDRON, WAGNER_V8, PENTAGONAL_PRISM} as a minor.
case_3.negative_certificate: Explicit minor model for one selected forbidden graph H.

OCTAHEDRON.definition: K6 minus the three disjoint nonedges o0-o1, o2-o3, o4-o5.

minor_model_verifier.input: Selected forbidden graph H and branch sets {B_v : v in V(H)} in the authoritative residual C.
requirements: For every v in V(H), the induced subgraph C[B_v] is connected.
For every edge uv in E(H), at least one original edge of C has one endpoint in B_u and one endpoint in B_v.
Extra adjacencies between branch sets corresponding to nonedges of H are allowed and do not invalidate a minor model.
minor_model_verifier.consequence: Contract each branch set and delete extra vertices/edges to obtain H as a minor; since H is a forbidden minor for treewidth<=3, tw(C)>3.

universal_target: Determine whether every authoritative C11 PI residual component terminates in CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW3_LIST_READY.
exact_algorithm_if_universal: For each authoritative pair and each of four PI assignments, apply only frozen exact propagation/preprocessing.
Factor the remaining undecided graph into connected components with all fixed-boundary restrictions encoded in lists.
For each component first test global missing color and invoke List-3 when applicable.
Otherwise recognize tw<=3 and construct/verify a width-3 decomposition.
Run exact arbitrary-list DP over bags of size at most 4 and reconstruct a branch coloring.
Compute q33,q34,q43,q44 and the four-bit Pi mask.
Account for polynomial recognition, decomposition verification, DP, reconstruction, four assignments, and the polynomially enumerable pair family.

X1_UNIVERSAL_LIST3_OR_TW3_COLLAPSE.label: X1_UNIVERSAL_LIST3_OR_TW3_COLLAPSE
pass_requires: A theorem/proof-carrying argument from frozen authoritative-core hypotheses that every residual component is CONTRADICTION, L3_READY, or TW3_LIST_READY.
A polynomial graph-only recognition/decomposition procedure for the TW3 case.
Exact arbitrary-list DP/reconstruction on width-3 decompositions.
Exact polynomial accounting for every PI bit across all authoritative pairs.
No extension oracle and no general P7-free 4-coloring/list-4 oracle.
consequence_ceiling: All four PI bits become polynomially computable.
D1_PI_POLY_DISCOVERABLE may be promoted only with an exact binding receipt.
The <=16 Pi-mask quotient becomes polynomially discoverable.
P3_EXACT_PAIR_QUOTIENT may be promoted only with a separate exact binding receipt.

X2_TW3_FORBIDDEN_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDU.label: X2_TW3_FORBIDDEN_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDUAL
X2_TW3_FORBIDDEN_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDU.condition: A concrete authoritative residual component C survives frozen preprocessing, has no globally missing color, and contains one selected H in {K5,OCTAHEDRON,WAGNER_V8,PENTAGONAL_PRISM} as a proof-carrying minor.
certificate: exact propagated connected residual graph C
selected forbidden graph H from the frozen catalog
one nonempty branch set B_v for every v in V(H)
one original cross-edge witness for every uv in E(H)
independent verification of the complete minor model
X2_TW3_FORBIDDEN_MINOR_FOUR_COLOR_RESIDU.interpretation: Establishes only existence of an authoritative residual outside the current {List-3, treewidth<=3 arbitrary-list} terminal union.

X3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.label: X3_GATE_UNRESOLVED
X3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.condition: Neither universal X1 authority nor a complete authoritative X2 certificate is established.
X3_GATE_UNRESOLVED.interpretation: No hardness, lower-bound, or nonexistence conclusion.

positive_control.source: Previously sealed authoritative W2 K4 residual.
positive_control.interpretation: The old W2 K4 witness must not survive as X2.

classifier_controls.purpose: Verify all four forbidden-minor certificate schemas independently of scientific outcome.

anti_cheat: Failure of a heuristic width-3 decomposition search is not X2.
X2 requires an explicit minor model of one of the four frozen forbidden graphs.
A K4 minor is not enough for X2; K4 has treewidth 3 and is the positive control.
A cycle or multiple cycles are not enough for X2.
Finite enumeration alone cannot establish X1.
Do not infer unbounded treewidth from one X2 witness.
Do not use a general P7-free 4-coloring/list-4 oracle or an extension oracle.
forbidden: branching search beyond frozen deterministic propagation
next_action: Separate authorization required. Audit only the frozen {List-3, treewidth<=3 arbitrary-list} terminal union and stop at X1/X2/X3.
